sentences.text: Jeeshan Salmani vs State Of Uttarakhand on 10 November, 2023

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No. 130 of 2023
Jeeshan Salmani ........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent
Present:-
 Mr. Manoj Bhatt, Advocate for the applicant.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Bhaskar Chand Joshi, A.G.A. for the State.

Applicant Jeeshan Salmani is in judicial custody in Fir No.575 of 2022 dated 06.09.2022, under
Sections 323, 376, 504, 506 Ipc and Sections 5/6 of The Protection Of Children From Sexual
Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

He has sought his release
on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant is husband of the informant.
The applicant and his brother would harass, torture and beat the informant.
The FIR states that the applicant would molest the young girl also.
4. It is argued that it is a matrimonial discord; the young girl, who has been examined as PW2 at trial had not supported the prosecution case.
5. These facts are admitted by the learned State counsel.
6. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

7. The bail application is allowed.
8. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
